1. Install K8s: First, you need to install K8s on your local machine. You can use either the official K8s distribution or a third-party distribution like Rancher.
2. Install Nginx: Next, you need to install Nginx on your local machine. You can download Nginx from the official website and install it on your machine.

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap

listen 80;
server_name example.com;
location / {
root /usr/share/nginx/html;
}
}
4. Apply the ConfigMap: Apply the ConfigMap to your K8s cluster using the following command:
kubectl apply -f nginx-config.yaml
